title: PC-R7 naturalistic-domain obligation cell
theory_revision: A: obligation structure binds to naturalistic constraint structure (externally-authored, verifiable, consequential constraints are the working regime; internal constraints are mean-neutral)

parent_evidence.pc_status: GENERATED_CELLS_CONDITIONAL_SUPPORT_ONLY; decisive list requires >=1 naturalistic scientific-domain control; import map SD80 -> PC-C4
parent_evidence.e30_e60: terminal mean-null (E30-R11 480/480, E60 component null); tail endpoint owned by PC-R6
parent_evidence.fm80_protocol: research/experiments/FM80_NATURALISTIC_TRANSFER_DECISIVE_PROTOCOL_V1.md (domains, eligibility, remoteness, adjudication, resource parity - used as infrastructure, not altered)
parent_evidence.witness_sources: MLRC Journal Track (39 forum pages, linkage 24/30) + RP:P REGISTERED_REPLICATION_VERDICT (SD30/C3/C4 recon)

case_matrix.domains: FM80 s2: >=1 formal + 2 empirical sciences, >=30 eligible cases/domain

provenance_tag.rule: classify each case's binding constraints from the public record only, pre-outcome, blind to arms
provenance_tag.populations: >=15 cases/domain per tag before the cell may run, else INSUFFICIENT_ELIGIBLE_NATURALISTIC_CASES (contraction terminal)

arms.OBLIGATION: full P-C obligation-driven control (decompose, ledger, satisfy/defer, selective reopen)
arms.OBLIGATION_FREE: same model/budget/corpus/output contract, direct solve without the ledger
arms.parity: FM80 s5 resource parity verbatim; no donor/transfer machinery in either arm

endpoints.primary_external_stratum: case-level registered decision quality on the case's own verifiable outcome, FM80 s7 independent adjudication blind to arm, binary per case
endpoints.co_primary_safety: CRITICAL_CONSTRAINT_VIOLATION (incl. silent constraint drops), non-compensatory, both strata

statistics.design: paired within case; risk differences, exact paired tests, 95% intervals; Holm across >=3 domain-level primary tests
statistics.strata: pre-registered: external stratum is THE primary; internal stratum non-inferiority margin +5pp

gates.GN0_INTAKE_VALID: two independent taggers, >=90% agreement on 20-case calibration set pre-run, disagreements adjudicated before run
gates.GN1_EXTERNAL_BINDING: external stratum: OBLIGATION >= OBLIGATION_FREE by >=10pp in >=2/3 domains, Holm CIs excluding 0
gates.GN2_INTERNAL_HARMLESS: internal stratum RD upper bound <= +5pp AND no CRITICAL_CONSTRAINT_VIOLATION increase in any stratum

routing_preregistered.GN0_fail_or_insufficient: INSUFFICIENT_ELIGIBLE_NATURALISTIC_CASES contraction terminal; P-C closes on generated+boundary contract
routing_preregistered.GN1_and_GN2_pass: theory A survives; PC-C4 evidence; P-C result block re-opened under new freeze
routing_preregistered.GN1_fail_GN2_pass: theory A refuted; regime boundary stated as registered result; P-C closes
routing_preregistered.GN2_fail: obligations harm naturalistic execution; contraction matrix + manuscript limitation

no_rescue_clause: no generated-cell re-reading; no transfer claim (FM80 owns it); no endpoint/stratum-margin/arm/tagging-rule change after intake begins; no claim until the cell executes under its own dispatch freeze

custody.freeze: this PR; tagging rule + runner freeze in the dispatch PR
